preconditions.description: The dimensions of the tables A and B are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= n for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in table A are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i][j] <= n for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in table B are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a valid number of sortings followed by the columns.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(1 <= int(c) <= m for c in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, all column numbers are within the specified bounds.
The number of columns matches the specified number of sortings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (lambda A, B, cols: all(A[i] == B[i] for i in range(n)))(A, B, [int(c) for c in stdout.split()[1:]])
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, applying the specified sortings to A results in B.
